sloka: स एवमुक्त्वा द्युतिमान् वचनं भ्रातुरग्रतः।स रावणिवधाकाङ्क्षी लक्ष्मणस्त्वरितो ययौ ।। ६.८५.२८ ।।
transliteration: sa evamuktvā dyutimān vacanaṁ bhrāturagrataḥ।sa rāvaṇivadhākāṅkṣī lakṣmaṇastvarito yayau ।। 6.85.28 ।।

translations.english: Brilliant Lakshmana, having spoken that way in front of his brother, went speedily desirous of killing Ravana's son.
